title: Cloud Nurdz | ICED | Grape Strawberry ICED 100ml
description:
Cloud Nurdz – Grape Strawberry ICED 100ml
A mouthwatering combination of juicy strawberry and luscious grapes, making a sweet, tart flavor with a kick of candy with added ice.
Primary Flavours:
Vine-ripened grape and sweet strawberries
Ratio:
70VG/30PG
Bottle Size:
100ml
Nicotine:
0mg
Cloud NURDZ Eliquid is well known for its selection of wild candied flavor vape juice. Each packed with flourishing flavor that you can never get tired of starting from sour, sweet, and iced out menthol in many different combinations giving you the full range of candy explosion. With Cloud NURDZ you would have no need to leave the house to get a pack of candy, all you need is right here in this very line of vape juice. No cavities, no sticky stuff on your teeth, just sweet candy delight on the inhale and exhale. How could you beat that?
